name: realm-play
description: Use one authenticated, world-bound REALM gameplay backend through a local stdio MCP host.

interface.longDescription: Local-only REALM tools for an authenticated player to observe and act through the game's authoritative Gateway and Engine. Requires the matching REALM source, an existing world, a host-provisioned player token and a compatible local MCP host. Does not connect ChatGPT Web to a remote machine.
interface.defaultPrompt: Explore the host-configured REALM world with me. Confirm the player/world binding, observe before acting, and report only authoritative results.
